schemaDelta.principle: All nine Scum and Villainy weapon claims can be represented faithfully with structures already established through Rebellion Era v2.7. Do not create v2.8 merely because individual triggeredEffects, activationRequirements, or payload rules are more complex.
schemaDelta.sourceQualityRule: Scum and Villainy Table 2-7 uses the standard Accurate rule (no short-range penalty) and Inaccurate rule (cannot fire at long range). Neural Inhibitor and Micro Grenade Launcher are Inaccurate; Sniper Blaster Rifle is Accurate.
representationNotes: Micro Grenade Launcher uses existing conditionalDamageProfiles[].diceCountDelta=-2 plus payloadProfiles inheritance notes; this is not a new schema family.
Neural Inhibitor uses structured triggeredEffects for the persistent secondary poison attack, cumulative failure bonus, cure, and termination.
Electronet uses deliveryMethod plus triggeredEffects for grenade-launcher delivery, grab-on-hit, and recurring stun while trapped.
Squib Battering Ram uses activationRequirements and wieldingRules for its two-operator use and source target restrictions.

verification.errataCheck: January 2009 Scum & Villainy errata/clarifications contain no weapon-stat or weapon-rule changes for pp.49-52.

bookLocalGuardrails: Do not update a rolling/master weapon authority from this package.
Do not mutate production packs, template/schema runtime, actors, feats, or talents during certification.
Do not create any new production weapon records; all nine Scum and Villainy claims are repo-present.
Repo fields are comparison evidence only.
Do not bump the authority schema beyond v2.7 for this book unless the verifier proves an actual unrepresentable source mechanic.
Do not treat Neural Inhibitor as kinetic; the table prints Piercing. Do not accept repo heavy-weapons range as source authority.
Do not treat Pulse Rifle or Deck Sweeper as ordinary heavy-weapons-range attacks; each source attack is a fixed 6-square cone.
Do not treat Electronet as a standalone heavy weapon; it is ammunition that can only be fired from a grenade launcher.
Do not flatten Deck Sweeper, Electronet, or Snare Rifle native stun into ordinary lethal damage fields.
Do not convert Subrepeating Blaster ROF A into merely autofire-capable; the prose explicitly makes it autofire-only.
Do not allow the Subrepeating Blaster to brace for autofire unless its retractable stock is extended.
Do not treat Micro Grenade Launcher as Military; the table prints Illegal. Preserve payload inheritance and the -2 damage-dice transform.
Do not treat Snare Rifle as kinetic; the table prints Bludgeoning. Preserve ranged grab/grapple and feat restrictions.
Do not remove the two-operator requirement or target limitations from Squib Battering Ram, and preserve the four-power-pack operating requirement.
Do not make bipod or targeting scope mandatory/included-cost parts of the Sniper Blaster Rifle; the source says they are often mounted and not included in the listed cost.
Do not omit the Sniper Blaster Rifle -5 attack penalty when the wielder has not Aimed at the target immediately before the attack.

Structure-only aliases to existing v2.7 shapes, no published fact changed: Neural Inhibitor: range.allowedBands null (no printed range profile; the Inaccurate band set stays in qualityParameters), triggeredEffects entry given an effect key; Pulse Rifle / Deck Sweeper: fixed-maximum range maxSquares 6 (hardMaxSquares kept); Deck Sweeper onMiss half-stun-damage -> half-damage with onMissDetail; Electronet weaponGroup case aligned to Phase 1 "Heavy Weapon (Ammunition)"; Subrepeating Blaster: retractable-stock sourceRule; firingConstraints completed with the shared fields (autofireOnly/braceRule kept); Sniper Blaster Rifle: bipod/targeting scope are commonly mounted, not source-integrated, so they leave integratedAccessories[] (contract: never add commonly mounted accessories) and stay in operation.commonAccessoriesNotIncludedInListedCost; Squib Battering Ram two-operator wieldingRule given a condition; Snare Rifle escape-options triggeredEffect given an effect key; Micro Grenade Launcher: stun payload-derived -> ammunition-dependent/ammunition; configurationStates attackUsable (standalone true, rifle-mounted null = not stated); conditionalDamageProfile operation add-dice-count -> add-dice (detail kept).
